recording.decodedBy: Unity AudioClip.GetData; original Vorbis importer retained

inferenceInputs: Verified actual imported float32 little-endian PCM

models.name: UVR Kim Vocal 2
models.license: UVR project code: MIT. For the public model, upstream asks users to credit UVR and its developers; no model weights are redistributed here.
models.credit: Ultimate Vocal Remover; Anjok07, aufr33; Kim Vocal 2 model by UVR contributors

featureEvidence.canonicalEncoding: Signed int64 little-endian, floor(value*1e8+0.5), including typed array lengths and recording/model identity
featureEvidence.pitchTiming: Native Basic Pitch frame times, approximately 86 Hz

classifier.rule: Legato, plateau release, returning ornament, adaptive upper-register pickup, cadence/rest fill and confirmed glide handoff
classifier.releaseSnapInput: Physical high-frequency PCM attacks; vocal envelope starts excluded
classifier.musicalPolicies: Cadence/rest and glide handoff use measured pulse and note duration; their endpoints are gameplay phrasing, not literal vocal offsets
classifier.pickupAndGlideContinuity: Reject 60 ms of consecutive RMS below 10% of phrase peak, with a 0.005 peak floor; explicit cadence/rest policy remains exempt

reproduction.cache: Ignored Library only; model weights and intermediate audio are not committed

evaluation.scope: Repeated within-song calibration; not a blind or unseen-song test

classifierFixtures.scope: Synthetic counterfactual measurements; not a source-separation or unseen-song benchmark
